title: jsc2026m000151_Meet_Roscosmos_Cosmonaut_Sergey_Teteryatnikov_Crew13_Mission_Specialist_SOCIAL
description: Roscosmos cosmonaut Sergey Teteryatnikov is a mission specialist for NASA’s SpaceX Crew-13 mission. This is his first spaceflight. Upon his arrival to the International Space Station, he will join Expedition 75, kicking off a long-duration science expedition aboard the orbiting laboratory. He was selected for the Gagarin Research and Test Cosmonaut Training Center Cosmonaut Corps in 2021 and has served as a test cosmonaut since 2023. He graduated from the Naval Academy, St. Petersburg, Russia, in 2011 as an engineer specializing in ship power plant operations. He also served in various naval engineering roles, including undersea vessels and specialized engine room operations.
